title: The Best Garage Door Openers with Built-In Wi-Fi
subtitle: Full garage door openers with Wi-Fi built in, ranked.
intro: We pulled the complete garage door openers on Amazon with built-in Wi-Fi and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: belt drive, battery backup, built-in camera, and smart home support.
systems_note: Chamberlain, LiftMaster, and Craftsman openers use the myQ app. Genie openers use Aladdin Connect, which also has an official Home Assistant integration.

buyers_guide.a: Belt drives are much quieter, which matters if there's a bedroom over the garage. Chain drives cost less and handle heavy doors well.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need a smart opener or just a smart controller?
buyers_guide.a: If your opener works, a smart controller like myQ or meross adds app control for far less. Replace the whole opener if it's old, noisy, or lacks safety sensors.

buyers_guide.q: Does myQ work with Home Assistant or Google?
buyers_guide.a: Chamberlain's myQ works with its own app, Amazon Key, and some car brands, but no longer supports Home Assistant or Google Home directly. Genie's Aladdin Connect works with Alexa and Google.
